The lightest portable power station I found with at least 2,000Wh of battery capacity is the Anker SOLIX S2000 at 35.7 lb (16.2 kg). It holds 2,010Wh and delivers 1,500W of continuous AC power.

I treated 2,000Wh as a minimum rated capacity, not a 2,000W output requirement, and compared standalone stations without solar panels. I couldn't establish an exhaustive worldwide minimum, but the Anker is the lightest verified model I found.

The lightest self-contained power station I found with at least 2,000Wh is the Anker SOLIX S2000, at 35.7 lb (16.2 kg). It has 2,010Wh of capacity and a 1,500W AC inverter. The main tradeoff is output power, not battery capacity.

Anker SOLIX S2000

$729.99

Outbound Power

35.7 lb · 2,010Wh · 1,500W output. Best if minimum carrying weight is your priority.

Jackery Explorer 2000 v2

$999.00

Renewable Outdoors

39.5 lb · 2,042Wh · 2,200W output. Worth the extra 3.8 lb if you need to run higher-wattage appliances. 
Jackery

I treated 2,000Wh as a minimum rated capacity, rather than usable AC energy, and compared station-only weights. The Anker's weight comes from a retailer listing; I couldn't independently confirm that no lighter model exists worldwide.
